notes.title: The demo version of The Way of the Tray is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/5a5a542397e1b51ede97fbee7c3acc01c0263544.png[/img]

Embark on a journey into the world of Japanese spirits right now!

Serve unusual orders to yokai and learn all the secrets of local cuisine – but most importantly, try to keep your tray balanced.

Share your impressions and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: The demo version of The Way of the Tray will be available very soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/5a5a542397e1b51ede97fbee7c3acc01c0263544.png[/img]

On April 29, everyone will have the chance to come face to face with mysterious yokai and try their hand at being a waiter in a Japanese restaurant!

Will you be able to keep your tray balanced?
